description: Defines the MachoID class for gathering identifying information from Mach-O files, including methods for retrieving UUIDs, CRC, and MD5 hashes, as well as handling file memory and parsing load commands.

classes.name: MachoID
classes.description: Class for extracting and computing identifiers from Mach-O files, including UUIDs, CRC, and MD5 hashes.

methods.name: MachoID
methods.description: Constructor that initializes MachoID with a file path.

methods.name: MachoID
methods.description: Constructor that initializes MachoID with a memory buffer.

methods.name: UUIDCommand
methods.description: Retrieves UUID from LC_UUID command for specified CPU type/subtype.

methods.name: IDCommand
methods.description: Retrieves UUID from LC_ID_DYLIB command for specified CPU type/subtype.

methods.name: Adler32
methods.description: Calculates Adler32 CRC for Mach-O data segments.

methods.name: MD5
methods.description: Calculates MD5 hash for Mach-O data segments.

methods.name: UpdateCRC
methods.description: Updates CRC value based on provided bytes.

methods.name: UpdateMD5
methods.description: Updates MD5 hash based on provided bytes.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Processes data from MachoWalker to update CRC or MD5.

methods.name: WalkHeader
methods.description: Creates a MachoWalker to parse Mach-O header and load commands.
